d: A massive inheritance battle has erupted within one of India's oldest business families — the TVS Group. Dr. Lakshmi Venu has reportedly sent a partition notice to her father, industrialist Venu Srinivasan, demanding a fair share in the family's business empire. While her brother Sudarshan Venu heads businesses worth a significantly larger amount, Lakshmi is associated with Sundaram-Clayton, raising questions about the unequal distribution of wealth and control.
